title: Week 5 Self-Management Check-In
subtitle: Clarify what you can manage independently and when support is useful.
description: Good self-management does not mean doing everything alone. It means using your tools, responding proportionately, and asking for the right support when needed.

sections.title: Update the plan
sections.description: Use new experience to update an old prediction.

fields.label: What activity or situation previously felt threatening or uncertain?
fields.placeholder: Describe the situation and the prediction you carried into it...

fields.label: What new information have you gained?
fields.placeholder: What can you now do, tolerate, modify, or understand differently?

sections.title: Continue, modify, or seek support
sections.description: Create guidance you can actually use.

fields.label: I may modify the task when:
fields.placeholder: Describe what tells you the dose or strategy needs adjustment...

fields.label: I will seek appropriate support when:
fields.placeholder: New or concerning symptoms, uncertainty, stalled progress, worsening function...

sections.title: Choose support intentionally
sections.description: Support should build capability, not replace it.

fields.label: Which support may be useful next?
options: Help modifying an activity or exercise
Support from family, friends, or work

fields.label: What specific question or request will I make?
fields.placeholder: Be clear about the help or information you need...

successMessage: Week 5 complete. You are building a clearer, more independent recovery decision process.
